result.topic_en: Laisant's list, sent to the editors, of the questions posed in the Nouvelles Annales de Mathématiques from 1863 to 1867 that had not yet been solved, given by question number and grouped by year.

result.notes_en: Under the heading 'Correspondance', the editors say that M. Laisant has sent them the list of questions in the Nouvelles Annales de Mathématiques that have remained unsolved since 1863, and that they hasten to publish it. The numbers are grouped by year (1863 to 1867) and printed in columns that run in ascending order down each column; the number_list follows that column order. For question 711, only parts II and III are listed as unsolved. A footnote marks question 673 as 'résolue incomplétement' (incompletely solved).
